{{Top|leg}}
The '''Resettlement Acts''' were a measure passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to allow for the charting of new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] and the colonization of new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] they discovered. It was financially supported by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], a fact that was&mdash;according to Damask himself&mdash;not very well known.
